text:
zoe: Heads up team—planning a small "mini-brief" newsletter to push the benchmark summary + on-demand demo. Target send next Wed. We want 3 subject tones and 4 audience slices. Who can own what?

dan: I’ll own segments. Slices: 1) Eng power users (last_14d), 2) Trials (started <60d), 3) Sales-sourced leads (crm tag), 4) Quiet (90-180d inactive). Different CTA mappings per slice.

li: Subject tones: (A) Data-first: "New benchmark: models, latency & cost" (B) Benefit-first: "Reduce inference costs without latency tradeoffs" (C) FOMO: "Limited demo — see benchmark highlights". Preheader options: "Benchmarks + actionable config" / "Register for quick demo".

maria: Send windows: US Tue 10am PT, EU Tue 10am GMT, APAC Wed 10am SGT. For quiet list we delay 48h and use tone C second send if no opens.

tim: Tracking params: ?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mini_brief_apr&utm_content={slice}_{variant}. Add header X-Experiment: mini_brief_subject_v1

li: SQL snippet for power users (will paste full in campaign doc):
```
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE last_active >= now() - interval '14 days' AND email_opt_in = true
```

dan: Suppress: unsubscribes, do-not-email tag, research-exempt, and any member of competitive-firm list.

maria: Creative: hero = compact heatmap + 2 CTAs (primary: "Download brief", secondary: "Watch demo"). For Trials swap primary to "Watch demo" and include short testimonial. Keep images <200KB.

deliverability-bot: Flag: Subject B uses "Reduce inference costs" — safe. Avoid phrases like "cut your bills". Also watch image-hosting domain for Gmail clipping.

zoe: Actions: dan = segment SQL + suppression (EOD), li = subject + preheader variants (EOD), tim = UTM headers + seed list (tonight), maria = creative + assets (tomorrow). I'll create preflight QA checklist and kick off a staging dry run.

tim: I'll run a 2k seed dry run to staging once assets are final. Tag me when ready.

zoe: Thanks all. If anyone sees wording that may trigger deliverability flags call it out here. Otherwise we'll follow this plan :sparkles:
